head: WORKTREE
summary: Movements endpoint is cleanly layered (use case, read-only service, SQL adapter, explicit web mapper), contract updated, amounts unsigned with direction derived from sign, ordering by occurred_at then posting id proven with out-of-order inserts on real PostgreSQL. All criteria proven by named tests; no blocker or major findings.

findings.description: Tests use @DisplayName with AC ids while the brief asks for tests named after the behaviour; method names are behavioural so this is acceptable. Tie-break by posting id is only proven at adapter level, not end to end.
